summary: @servicetitan/dte-pdf-editor preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute obfuscated sibling payload
details: package.json declares a preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) that runs automatically on `npm install`. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime (bun-v1.3.13) from GitHub releases into a temp directory with no hash/signature verification and then invokes that downloaded Bun binary to execute the sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a 727 KB Bun-compiled bundle with string-array-rotation obfuscation (`WV8StW` shift routine, `n7gIxM` opaque constant table, hex-mangled identifiers) and is not referenced by the library's own main entry (`dist/index.js`, which re-exports React PDF components matching the advertised purpose). The payload's contents have no plaintext relation to a PDF editor. This is the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern: a foreign runtime is fetched specifically so an obfuscated blob executes outside the Node module graph a normal audit would inspect. Because the flow is preinstall, arbitrary attacker-controlled code runs on the installer's machine on every `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
